# Data Integrity Checklist: ART-005 - Gallery Completion - Knowledge, Reports & Editors

**Purpose**: Validate data-integrity requirements quality for ART-005 live editor exports, manifest/export classification, edge-case representation, and stale-export prevention before task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist data-integrity` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the seven ART-005 artifact identifiers, upstream source files, digests, and reader/producer roles specified as the complete data set for this feature? [Completeness, Spec §Source, Fidelity, and Fill Regions]
- [x] CHK002 Are manifest export declarations specified exactly for all seven entries, with the four readers retaining `exports: []` and the three editors retaining only `["markdown"]`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Slice Stack And Branch Plan]
- [x] CHK003 Are per-slice artifact/status changes specified as atomic data updates so each template file, manifest status, export declaration, tests, generated refresh, and UAT row set stay in agreement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Contract §Slice Topology]
- [x] CHK004 Does the requirements set explicitly forbid precomputed or cached export strings and require every `Copy as Markdown` invocation to serialize a fresh live-state snapshot? [Resolved] [Spec §FR-010, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK005 Is a complete structured `issues[]` entry schema specified for invalid, unavailable, empty, and duplicate data conditions in structured editor exports? [Resolved] [Spec §Editor State and Export Contracts, Data Model §MarkdownExport]
- [x] CHK006 Are data-integrity UAT rows required for raw invalid input, duplicate identifiers, empty collections, multiline Unicode, quotes, backticks, pipes, and other special characters? [Resolved] [Spec §Acceptance Evidence and Reviewability, Contract §UAT Evidence]

## Deterministic Ordering

- [x] CHK007 Is `triage-board` export ordering fully specified by column order and current visible ticket order, including empty-column representation? [Clarity, Spec §Triage ordering, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK008 Are `feature-flags` group order, flag order, group fields, flag fields, and wrapper fields specified so the JSON payload can be compared byte-for-byte after parsing and re-stringifying? [Clarity, Spec §Feature-flag schema, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK009 Are `prompt-tuner` template, slot, sample, sample-field, and preview ordering rules specified without depending on object-key inference outside the declared schema? [Clarity, Spec §Prompt-tuner schema, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK010 Is use of `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` specified for structured JSON exports so whitespace and escaping are deterministic while values remain parseable JSON? [Clarity, Spec §Edge representation]
- [x] CHK011 Are multiple `issues[]` entries ordered deterministically when more than one invalid or duplicate condition is present in the same export? [Resolved] [Spec §Edge representation, Data Model §MarkdownExport]

## Lossless Typed JSON

- [x] CHK012 Are `feature-flags` JSON value types specified for group identifiers, labels, flag keys, descriptions, booleans, optional dependency references, rollout numbers, and `null` values? [Completeness, Spec §Feature-flag schema, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK013 Are `feature-flags` invalid rollout or dependency values specified to preserve the raw value, use `null` for unavailable normalized values, and add an issue without clamping, truncating, or coercing the raw input? [Resolved] [Spec §Edge representation, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK014 Are `prompt-tuner` JSON value types specified for template text, slot identifiers, sample identifiers, labels, plan class, sample fields, derived previews, and issue records? [Completeness, Spec §Prompt-tuner schema, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK015 Are multiline, Unicode, quote, backtick, pipe, slash, and control-character cases specified as data that must round-trip through the fenced JSON or Markdown export rather than being sanitized away? [Resolved] [Spec §Edge representation, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are empty text, empty collections, and absent optional fields consistently represented as `""`, `[]`, and `null` across both structured editor schemas? [Consistency, Spec §Edge representation, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK017 Are duplicate identifiers handled exactly for feature-flag groups, flag keys, prompt slots, prompt samples, and triage tickets, including preservation order and issue reporting without deduplication or renaming? [Resolved] [Spec §Edge representation, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK018 Are raw invalid inputs specified with both their original text and normalized value so validation errors remain auditable in exported data and visible UI feedback? [Resolved] [Spec §Edge representation, Spec §UX Boundary And Responsive Criteria]
- [x] CHK019 Are manifest duplicate identifier and orphan-file prevention requirements consistent with the existing gallery validation contract and scoped to the seven ART-005 entries? [Consistency, SPA Contract §Entry shape, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK020 Are stale manual-copy fallback contents, stale success messages, and stale previous-invocation export payloads required to be cleared or replaced before each new copy attempt? [Resolved] [Spec §Clipboard behavior, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Are success criteria measurable for 100% manifest/artifact agreement across shipped status, template existence, source file, role, and export declarations? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK022 Are editor success criteria measurable enough to prove that changing visible state changes the exported Markdown deterministically and does not reuse an earlier serialized value? [Resolved] [Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK023 Are edge-case outcomes measurable for raw invalid values, duplicate identifiers, empty collections, and multiline Unicode or special-character values in both UI feedback and exported text? [Resolved] [Spec §SC-007, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK024 Are clipboard-success and fallback criteria tied to equality against the exact attempted live-state export string for every producer? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Contract §UAT Evidence]
- [x] CHK025 Are `not_applicable` UAT rows required to carry data observations when an edge case does not apply to a specific reader or editor? [Acceptance Criteria, Contract §UAT Evidence]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, And Scope

- [x] CHK026 Are generated payloads, installed-cache mirrors, proof fixtures, and docs references treated as source-derived outputs regenerated from current source rather than edited or trusted as export data sources? [Consistency, Plan §Declared File Operations, Constitution §VI]
- [x] CHK027 Are state reset and memory-only requirements consistent with stale-export prevention, so reload restores representative seed data and never persists editor content, schema state, or raw invalid input? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Research §Keep State Session-Only]
- [x] CHK028 Are data-integrity requirements scoped to the seven ART-005 templates and their manifest rows without adding JSON export kinds, imports, downloads, storage, URLs, or shared gallery foundation behavior? [Scope, Spec §FR-019, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK029 Are the existing per-slice LOC ceilings preserved after data-integrity requirements are specified, with no slice projected to reach the 800-LOC block threshold? [Scope, Plan §Reviewability Checkpoint]
